name: arxiv-mcp
description: Browse 2M+ arXiv research papers as a virtual filesystem — full text, section files, LaTeX source, structured references, and live category subscriptions via the arxiv:/// URI scheme.

interface.shortDescription: Browse 2M+ arXiv papers as a virtual filesystem.
interface.longDescription: Exposes arXiv as a browsable virtual filesystem using MCP Resources. Navigate subject groups, categories, and papers as arxiv:/// URIs — then read the abstract, full text, LaTeX source, structured references, or individual sections as files. Includes arxiv_search, arxiv_get_paper, and arxiv_list_categories tools with full structured output schemas.
